Name: Aldis Lamp
Author: Sundowner
Description: Star Citizen virtual Aldis lamp: sends Morse phrases, single dots/dashes and lamp on/off toggles with correct PARIS timing (WPM). Each key recharges with a ring animated for exactly as long as its send takes. Includes a Stop action to cancel and extinguish. Windows only.

Actions.Name: Aldis Lamp
Actions.Tooltip: Signal with the ship's Aldis lamp: Morse phrase, dot, dash, or lamp on/off

Actions.Name: Aldis Stop
Actions.Tooltip: Cancel the running send, clear the queue and extinguish the lamp
